## Goal
- Complete the "FINAL IVX CAPITAL PLATFORM COMPLETION — EXECUTE, VERIFY, DEPLOY" mandate: run real Phase 8 QA, fix all failures, deploy, and produce verified evidence across all 10 phases. Then audit + fix IVX IA chat routing bugs per owner's new request.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_SENSITIVE_OPERATION, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — must use Install tool
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — large files >~30KB MUST use gzip-base64; Python `zlib.compress(raw, 9, 31)` (wbits=31 = gzip format, NOT wbits=15 = deflate which causes "incorrect header check"); omit `contentEncoding` for small files
- Render deploy API: same action endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login; length ~1620; expires frequently — re-mint as needed)
- `/tmp/` files get wiped by sandbox resets — recreate via heredoc each time
- Watchman refuses to start in low-priority sandbox (nice_value=19) — must exclude from PATH via `/tmp/nowatch` dir with shim script that exits 1
- Generated TypeScript code embedded inside outer template literals is DANGEROUS — `${...}` in generated code is eagerly evaluated by outer template → ReferenceError → worker crash. MUST use array-join with string concatenation instead.
- `pkill` commands cause shell exit code 128 in this sandbox — use `kill -9 <pid>` or `ps -ef | grep` + manual kill instead
- `bun test backend/` = 1480 tests across 110 files (~2.4s); `bunx tsc --noEmit` at root for full typecheck

## Key Decisions
- EXDEV fix: write temp file in SAME directory as target (intra-device rename) instead of `os.tmpdir()` (cross-device rename fails with EXDEV)
- Extended `ProofLedgerInput` with 7 new optional fields rather than changing existing call sites — backward compatible
- Added `[key: string]: unknown` index signature to `LiveFeatureTestResult` + `ParityResult` so they're assignable to `Record<string, unknown>` in `ProofLedgerInput` fields
- Exported previously-private `runLiveFeatureTest` + `assertExactlyOneTerminalState` from recovery module for worker import (no circular dep — recovery doesn't import worker)
- gzip-base64 encoding: `zlib.compress(raw, 9, 31)` — wbits=31 = gzip format; wbits=15 (default) = deflate format → "incorrect header check" HTTP 400
- Four-layer router guard: all 4 short-circuit paths must be guarded
- Array-join pattern for generated code: NEVER embed generated TS inside outer template literal
- App scaffold creates 4 files with `node:test` (not `bun:test`) for import-smoke compatibility
- `extractAppName` regex: match `called X` / `named X` FIRST (before `app X`)
- `isServerBugFixRequest` uses 3 regex patterns: `fixServer` (fix the server/backend/api), `serverIncident` (server is down/crashed/offline), `fixServerSpecific` (fix server crash/outage/error) — added to both `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock` and `isSelfDeveloperExecutionPrompt` so short prompts route to senior-developer runtime instead of falling through to reliability gate

4. Deploy to Render via `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`
5. Verify 3-way SHA parity (GitHub HEAD = Render = Runtime)
6. Live-verify IVX IA chat endpoint with a "fix server crash" test prompt to prove it now routes to senior-developer runtime instead of BLOCKED
7. Post proof/evidence to owner chat
